mapper.select: SELECT ID, CABINET_NO, TOOL_CODE, POSITION, STATUS, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM TOOL_CABINET_INVENTORY WHERE CABINET_NO = #{cabinetNo} ORDER BY POSITION
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TOOL_CABINET_INVENTORY (CABINET_NO, TOOL_CODE, POSITION, STATUS) VALUES (#{cabinetNo}, #{toolCode}, #{position}, #{status})

INSERT ALL
INTO TOOL_CABINET_INVENTORY (ID, CABINET_NO, TOOL_CODE, POSITION, STATUS) VALUES (#{item.id}, #{item.cabinetNo}, #{item.toolCode}, #{item.position}, #{item.status})
SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
